name: Inkwell
description: Write it down, draw it out, get it done: notes with images and drawings, tasks, a focus timer, and a calendar.

store.tagline: Notes, tasks, a focus timer, and a calendar in one calm little workspace.
store.description:
Inkwell is a fast, Apple Notes–style personal workspace that keeps your writing, your to-dos, and your days in one quiet place.

• Notes with rich text, images, and drawings — headings, lists, checklists, tables, code blocks, highlights, and note-to-note links. Group them into colour-coded projects, pin the important ones, and find anything with full-text search.
• Tasks with smart lists (Today, Upcoming, All, Completed), plain-words quick add like “Call Ana fri 18:00 !high #work”, steps, priorities, repeats, and reminders. Turn any checklist line into a task that stays in sync.
• A Pomodoro focus timer with a gentle bell that rings on time even in a background tab, and counts finished sessions on the task you worked on.
• A calendar with week, day, and month views, drag-to-create and drag-to-move events, linked notes, attachments, and your dated tasks shown right alongside.
• A Home screen that pulls today together: recent notes, what’s due, what’s coming up, and your focus time.

Deleted notes are kept for 30 days so nothing disappears by accident.

Everything stays private to you: your notes, tasks, and events live in your own Möbius storage and are never shared unless you choose to.
